name: Ease
summary: Ease is a benefits administration system sold to insurance brokers, who pay for a Pro, Agency or Enterprise subscription and offer it to small-group clients. It offers carrier connections in three forms and sends eligibility data to carriers through 834 files, with a published list of more than 100 carriers. Subscription prices are not listed, but the FAQ gives add-on prices such as $6 per employee per form per year for ACA 1095 B and C forms.

facts.text: Brokers pay for Ease subscriptions in three tiers (Pro, Agency and Enterprise); employers go through their broker, and customer support carries no extra cost.

The FAQ prices EaseHR at $1 PEPM for brokers to enable and $2 PEPM for employers. It puts payroll integration at typically $0 to $1.50 PEPM and ACA 1095 B and C forms at $6 per employee per form per year.
For EaseConnect+ carriers, Ease's team reviews, sets up and maintains the connection; for EaseConnect carriers, Ease supports the broker through setup.
Ease sends eligibility data for medical, dental, vision and pharmacy benefits to carriers in 834 files, and its published carrier list says it tops 100 carriers.

hiddenCosts: EaseHR costs $1 PEPM for brokers to enable and $2 PEPM for employers.
Payroll integrations typically cost $0 to $1.50 PEPM, with partner-specific setup fees where they apply.
ACA 1095 B and C forms cost $6 per employee per form per year.
